batting.name: FY Fazal
batting.dismissal: c CA Pujara b SE Bond

batting.name: AA Jhunjhunwala
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b I Sharma

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b AB Dinda

batting.name: P Dogra
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b I Sharma

batting.name: SK Warne
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SE Bond

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c AC Voges b MM Patel

balls.text: well bowled by Ishant, sees him back away and bowls a full and wide one, out of Voges's reach, but Munna is alert and he sneaks through a bye
into the pads, flicked away square, and he runs hard, too quick for the throw, and makes it easily in for the second, retains strike
Voges is finishing well! slower ball picked up early and he semi-sweeps it over midwicket, the bottom hand and the wrist provide him with the power
Munna does his job, backs away, cuts, gets a single, Voges on strike now
he is cross, he is disappointed, slower ball, on the pads, short fine up, that should have gone for four - instead he gets just one leg-bye

lovely straight shot, more you see of him, more he reminds of Clarke! Risk-free batting at good pace, misses his yorker length by inches and he gets under it and smacks it for a straight, low six - the first of the innings
good finish for Bond, yorker outside off, Voges digs it out for a single and retains strike
full and straight, he can get just a single down to long-on
good old-fashioned slog from Munna, and he manages to get it to land safe in the deep midwicket area, comes back for two
full and straight, hit down to long-on for one
Shane gets Shane! Looks to chip it over extra-cover but gets it way too straight, hitting it down long-off's throat
gets a bottom edge for a single to point
length ball on the pads and he misses out, the short fine leg is up but all he gets is a leg-bye
misses out on the square drive, good over so far
length ball, driven inside-out, gets a single to sweeper-cover
edged and gone! poor shot really. wide delivery outside off and he goes after it and has to really reach out to be able to edge it. Would have been wide had he let it be
hits a length ball down to long-on for one
and Jhunjhunwala misses the fifty! makes room to club it into the leg side, the ball follows him and gets him high on the bat, and it's an easy catch at midwicket
looks for the grovel shot past short fine but finds Ishant, gets a single
slightly short, slightly outside off, punched away to short extra for one
full and fast into the pads with short fine up, flicked away for two
comes down the track and goes inside-out, the turn takes it square as opposed to over cover
fired into the pads, gets a single down to long-on
they steal a single to short third, Voges is too quick
uff an over full of slower balls, and he gets  thick edge on this one that beats short third man and gets him four more
cut away, not much pace to work with, straight to point
he is bowling only slower ones, I'll let you know when he bowls the change-up quick delivery, dragged from outside off and gets a single to square leg
slower ball again, and he runs it down to third man again
another slower ball and he runs it down to third man for a single
starts off with a predictable slower ball and Jhunjhunwala is waiting and has crashed it square for four
another slower legcutter, good spell from Dinda comes to an end with a single to point
full delivery, hit down the ground, gets a single to long-on
slower bouncer, and he pulls it into the gap again, gets a couple again
Voges is timing and placing them well, into the hips and punched away square, wide of the fielder, for two
slower legcutter, gets a single to backward point
angled into him, pretty quick, no room, cramps him
driven down to long-on for one
guides it to short third man, and gets a single
driven against the turn, first shot in the IPL and it's a cracker, past extra cover
plays with the turn, gets a single to long-on
tries another square drive, gets a thick edge and even better result, in the air but past backward point
square-drives a full delivery for a couple - one run called short by the umpire

Dinda has got Pathan, good intelligent T20 bowling on a flat slow wicket! After slower offcutter, slower bouncer, slower bouncer, yorker, gives him a regulation bouncer this time, 126ks, it chases him on the shot and it gets the high part of the bat and he holes out to deep square leg
low full toss outside off, guided down to third man
slower legcutter tried this time, muscled down to long-on for one
full and fast and goes equally fast of his bat, but finds extra cover
slower bouncer, 112.7ks, Yusuf thinks of the pull but pulls out
starts with a slower ball, 106ks, Pathan pats it back to him
slower ball again, too full and wide and he slams it over point  - Rajasthan's 100 up in the 12th over, last match they couldn't get there in the whole innings
slower ball, checks his shot, gets it straight to midwicket
regulation short one, into the body, pulled away to fine leg for a single
slower bouncer, manages to keep it down on the cut shot, but doesn't beat point
bouncer into the body again, and he has pulled it in front of square, along the ground
bouncer, 140ks, gets on to him fast, still manages a single with the pull down to long-on
into the pads again, and turned around the corner for one
no cute bunt shots this time, bludgeons this square cut to sweeper-cover
leading edge as he looks to bunt it to leg for one, is safe
too straight this time, and is flicked away for one
flighted around off again, another dot ball
Karthik on target, around off stump, defended back to the bowler
Pathan 2, Bond 0 - pitched up, right in his slot, and gets it over the mid-off
and again, Jhunjhunwala runs it down to third man, Pathan back on strike
low full toss, hit down the ground, gets a single
delicate! dug into the body, moves out of the line, and then gets under it and guides it past the keeper, not much pace in the wicket here
steered away to third man, Yusuf back on strike
full outside off, and muscled away wide of sweeper-cover, gets only one
extra pace again, and Jhunjhunwala has used it cannily, to the left of short third man this time
paddle sweep, Shah does well to get a hand at short fine leg, they take on Mathews's arm again, and he is just in. My word, what a flat fast throw again
flat delivery again, hit straight to cover
this time it is a better call for the second, hit into the gap, wide of long-on, and they come back easily

poor call for second run! it's not too far of Mathews at deep fine leg and they still come through for the second and Mathews's flat rocket throw finds Ojha way short. Karthik doesn't collect it cleanly but the ball rebounds off his hands onto the top of the bails
nice shot, uses Karthik's pace, flat delivery and he opens the face and gets it between backward point and short third man
he is making them ball to his strength here, again he steps out, twitters his intent before he does so, Mathews bowls short and he is ready to play his favourite shot, into the gap too
slower ball again, gets a single to wide of point
length ball, hit down the ground, gets a single to long-off
slower ball, full this time, Ojha hits it back to Mathews
slower shot ball, Jhunjhunwala checks the pull shot, manages to keep it down, gets a single
short and wide, cut straight to square third man, gets a single
good finish to the over for Karthik, bowls straight and fields the defensive hit back
full, on the pads, fails to connect on the sweep but gets a leg-bye
smartly bowled, sees him come down, bowls flat, into the pads, and Ojha pads it away
angled into the pads, looks to work it on on, but is early into the shot
flicks this from in front of stumps, gets an easy single
fired down the leg side
flat delivery outside off, punched straight to extra cover
crashed down the ground, boom! length ball, gentle pace, outside off, and hit at twice the pace it came to him, and mid-off has no chance
didn't look the most convincing to begin with, was on the front foot, Mathews dug it in short, and he pulled it in front of square, one bounce for four
pushes a length ball to wide of mid-on, comes through for one
slower bouncer, Ojha does well to abort the big pull shot and guide it to short fine leg for a single
no cute steer shot this time, even though he is down the track, he cuts away powerfully in front of square, and finds the gap
looks to steer the first ball, can;t beat point
well maybe it's not exactly Faiz's day all the way, telegrams Bond before coming down the wicket and he bounces him, the mis-hit lobs straight to mid-off
slogs again, and is beaten by the slower one this time
this seems to Faiz's day, he exposes all stumps and slogs with all his might - as if the shot will be outlawed tomorrow - and gets an inside edge past short fine leg
hits across the line again, doesn't get it past mid-on
nicely bowled, nicely played, not too short but still got big around the throat, and Ojha still managed to keep it down and get it to thirdman
tip-and-run, to mid-off
slower ball on the pads, Sharma is lucky to get away with it as Fazal finds short fine leg with the flick
steered away from outside off, gets a single
superb shot, square cut, off the front foot, and it goes crashing past point
slower bouncer, fails to connect on the pull but gathers one leg-bye
steps down the track and hits him across the line into the leg side
straight delivery, played with an open face, can't get it past point
and he keeps the strike too, crashes it through the off side for a single to sweeper cover
incredible shot, capitalising on the strong off-side field, takes this from well outside off and dragged it to the square-leg boundary
walks down the track, Dinda angles it across him, he defends it to cover, and has hit too strongly to come for a quick single
wants a quick single but he has hit too powerfully to point and is sent back
digs it in short, Fazal deliberately gets inside the line such that he can pull it fine, and he does exactly that and beats the square fine leg
slapped down the ground, disdain, pure disdain, and he gets four for it
punched away to wide of mid-off, comes through for a single
defended back to the bowler, straight and pitched on a length
too far down the leg side, Fazal tries for a shot over the infield but fails to connect
nice little pick-up shot off the pads, slightly fuller and in his hitting zone and Fazal gets under it and lofts it over square leg
tucks him up with a back-of-a-length delivery, no room there
pushes a length delivery to cover
short of a length, outside off, guided away to third man
starts off with a wide outside off stump
walks down the track and swipes across it as if in an ATM, gets four past mid-on
guides a shortish delivery to third man and comes through for one
plays a length ball with an open face towards point
short this time, pushes to Ganguly at mid-on and rushes through for one
another big lbw appeal, this time though it started straight and would perhaps have misses the leg stump. Hawk-eye says kissing leg stump, Koertzen goes with his instinct

Lumb is plumb! Couldn't have been plumber had he been fixing pipes! Stays in the crease, walks across the stumps, Dinda bowls full, shapes in a bit, and he misses, and Rudi Koertzen's finger goes up slowly and surely
dot ball, and Rajasthan are officially on the board
take a single to third man
slower legcutter, plays it like a spitting cobra, gets a single

Mathews is the new man in, and he walks out without even facing a delivery! Another yorker on the base of leg, they come through for a single, and Raut - the substitute - hits stumps direct from short fine
he mis-hits again, finds a fielder this time, but it is too late for KKR I am afraid. Like Hodge, another insipid innings, gets too much under a length ball and holes out to deep midwicket
yorker outside off, dot ball, all over except for no-balls and wides
another yorker chasing his toes, goes between his legs
and again, another of Ganguly's shots falls just in front of a fielder, plays the upper-cut, but doesn't put any power into it. Faiz at third man does well to get his body behind the half-volley
nice yorker, into the base of leg stump, just a single
makes so much room for himself he could have put a bed in there, and Tait coolly bowls a wide yorker and gets a dot
Ganguly can't even get himself out! bouncer, top-edged limply, and it falls between mid-off and mid-on and Shah almost runs himself out by plonking his foot in, just in!
gets the yorker right this time, will be just a single to long-on
Ojha you champ! full, fast, way down the leg side, he flings full length down the leg side, saves four wides
full toss, hit powerfully to Lumb at midwicket, they get a single despite the misfield
this time he is expecting the slower ball, and times the slog perfectly, carves him for six over wide midwicket, is it too late?
goes for the big slog, ends up playing it three seconds before the ball arrives, comprehensively beaten
walks across the stumps to get it over short fine, Sid bowls the slower ball, he misses, and I wonder why they didn't go for the lbw shout! He was dead!
slower ball, right up to the stumps, hit powerfully and slightly wide of long-off, gets a couple
slower bouncer, Ganguly has no clue about it, limply plays it to short fine, they don't even come through for one
misses the yorker this time, ends up a fulltoss and you could almost here the sigh of relief from Shah as he freed his arms and swung it high over long on. Six, they need more of those.
slow but very well directed yorker from Munaf, and what's more runs to his left and lunges to save a run.
113 kph, drags the slower ball with no timing to deep midwicket
slow fulltoss outside off and Dada can't capitalise, Drives straight to cover and does not run
full outside off, guided straight to short third. There is a run out chance at the non-striker but the fielder fumbles.
slower ball, picked to square leg for one
nice shot, Ganguly is fighting, makes room and swats a length delivery down the ground, neither mid-off nor mid-on has a chance
yorker that follows him as he looks to make room, just a single to midwicket
good cover-drive, but Warne has placed himself expertly at short extra cover
length ball, gets no timing on it, will take a single to mid-on
steered to third man, Trivedi runs to the other side, then recovers, enough time for Ganguly to come back
another mis-hit from Ganguly, clears front foot, premeditates the pull, but Tait is too quick for him, and just manages to clear mid-on
makes room and punches it away to sweeper-cover for one
is beaten on the big sweep shot, and survives the lbw because of too much turn
mis-hits the inside-out chip, too fast for him, and it lands just short of sweeper-cover
hit down the ground, gets a single to long-on
quick sharp offbreak, no room, defended
bowled him! Hodge's insipid innings comes to an end, steps out too early, Pathan fires in at 101ks, short too, squeezes through the gap and he is gone!
short, turning away, gets a single to sweeper-cover
beautifully bowled, pitches way outside off, turns back in sharply, cramps him up
Ganguly looks to pull, is hurried into it with a quicker delivery, the uppish mis-hit lands safe
Ganguly steps down again, Warne pulls the length back, but Ganguly hits powerfully down the ground, Lumb dives from long-on and saves two
stays back for a fullish delivery, waits for it to turn and then cuts it to sweeper-cover
floated outside off, cut away for a single
swept away in the air, one bounce to long leg
looks to make room, Pathan follows him with a full and fast delivery, dot ball
no one saving one on the leg side and Ganguly bunts it into the space and hares back for two
Sid T lets away three runs in front of his home crowd, hit power fully down to long-on, but Trivedi is slow in getting down and it rebounds off his knee
fired away at the pads, turning towards middle, played back to the bowler
into the pads, flicked away for one
Nearly got him there! Ganguly doesn't usually miss when he steps down to spinners, but this one dips in front of him, and he is beaten. Ojha fails to collect. Was there an inside edge there?
sharp turn from outside leg, helped away around the corner
desperate slog, clears the front leg and swings, mis-hit but gets it wide enough of midwicket
on the pads again, can't do much with it
nicely flighted outside off, pretends to play a shot with the bat behind the pad, gets a leg-bye
full, and swept away for one
length ball, pushed to midwicket
slower bouncer outside leg stump, Ganguly wants to get out of the way, that's the first instinct. But at the last moment he just guides it past the keeper, smart shot

bowled him! That's not Pujara's shot, not from what I have seen in domestic cricket! Walks across the stumps, gets on a knee, ready for the heave over short fine, Sid T bowls a slower ball, and all he manages is an inside edge onto the middle stump
slower ball, into the pads, worked away to deep square
comes down the track and punches a back-of-a-length delivery to sweeper-cover
short ball, not much behind it, pulled away for one
pushed down to long-off, stayed in crease this time
nearly got him, Warne is feeling it again! Drift and dip, sharp, Pujara who has stepped out of the crease, suddenly finds himself short of the delivery, somehow gets bat to it and steals a single
short, cut away through covers for one
ho ho ho ho, Hodge looks to come down, Warne shortens it slightly, even Hodge can see a stumping coming, hence aborts the shot and pads it away
upright sweep from in front of stumps, gets a couple, square of fine leg
paddled away from outside leg, and it's placed fine
slower ball, dragged powerfully into the leg side, gets a single
into the pads, worked away for a single
dropped by Jhunjhunwala, running in from sweeper-cover and getting under a mis-hit from Pujara, gets both hands under it but can't control it as he falls down
pushed to cover for one

Ojha is too smart for his own good, sees Hodge look to open the face and moves to his right even before he sees it is a slower offcutter that beats everything, and also Ojha. Had he stood his ground he would have kept this easily
short outside off, dabbed away to third man for one
stays back and short-arms it to wide of long-on to take a couple
Pujara jumps out of the crease, the ball dips on him, he manages to get a single into the on side
too full, outside leg, swept away for a single
too full this time, flicked away into the leg side for a single
yes there is drift there, Hodge stays back, is hurried into it and pushes it down to long-on
hint of drift into the pads, and slight legbreak, punched away for one
hit powerfully, but one bounce to cover
cut away powerfully, to left so sweeper-cover but Munaf does well to stick his foot out and save two runs
flighted outside off, nicely driven away, gets a single to sweeper-cover
cut in front of square, takes a single to sweeper-cover
opens the face on the cut shot, gets a single to short third
short outside off, cut straight to cover-point
good start for Sid T, just the on run in the over, slower ball on the stumps, and he makes room to open the face but hits it straight to short third
Hodge shows signs of frustration, jumps out of the crease and swings and misses
slower ball again, not quite the driving length, hit straight to backward point
length ball, nicely punched away, but straight to extra cover
slower ball outside off, steered away for a single
back of a length, punched straight to cover-point - Jhunjhunwala could have done a hammie here while bending down to field the ball
slower ball, guided wide of backward point for his first single out his score of 17
another poor delivery and he pays for it this time, full toss and flicked away wristily, all good-looking shots so far
poor delivery, half-volley at gentle pace, hit back and Munaf does well to save four in his follow through
slower ball this time, slightly shorter in length too, beats him with the offcut
pitched up and sweetly hit through the covers, lovely touch, no power, just timing
starts with a typical Munaf delivery, just short of driving length, just outside off, gives away a single to third man
pitched up, in the hitting zone, good-looking off-drive finds Munaf at mid-off
finally finds the gap, there is extra bounce, gets on his toes to get on top of it, and cuts it between backward point and short point
another crisp shot, short and cut away but finds the point fielder
another nice shot, punched off the back foot, but straight to cover
fast full toss on the pads, and Pujara thanks him with a nice clip to square leg

Jhunjhunwala has demolished the stumps! dropped at his feet and Pujara calls him through for one, Jhunjhunwala charges in from cover, dives for the ball, deflects it onto the stumps and goes shoulder first into the wood work. Pujara's dive sees him in
timber! the leg-side field works for Rajasthan, Tiwary again looks to manufacture a cut shot into the off side and Yusuf is too full and too fast and he is ecstatic too
quicker delivery, 98ks, cramps him too, defended back to him
nice shot, set himself up by making room and then chipping over the cover ring - there is no deep fielder on the off side
flighted around the middle stump, pushed to deep midwicket
pushes an offbreak to midwicket for a single
93ks, on the pads, flicked away for one
full and fast and sliding down leg, will be a leg-bye
lovely shot! Tait tries the bouncer, the pitch is not too quick, and Hodge is onto it, rolls his wrists over the pull shot and gets it past midwicket
tip-and-run, around off, and they make it despite a direct-hit from Yusuf Pathan
stays back of a length, there is leg cut on it again, and Tiwary shoulders arms this time
good follow-up delivery, back of a length, natural leg-cut on it with the slingy action, beats Tiwary's poke
full and fast, 144ks, beats Tiwary for pace, but the lbw shout is not upheld because it is sliding down the leg side
flighted around off, pushed back to the bowler
this time the offbreak follows him again but he manages it wide enough of cover for one
looks to make room this time, but the offbreak cramps him
on the off stump this time, flighted too, Tiwary pushes to cover
that's what the strong leg-side field does to you, gets too straight, and is glanced away past short fine
holds onto the pitch a bit, Tiwary pats it back to him
